1.why: The editor type control pushes a dedicated picker navigation key.

2.why: Selection writes through the repository immediately; the editor has no draft type updated by the picker.

3.why: The picker back action only navigates back and makes no type write.

4.why: The picker persists the type on selection, while the workout Save path only saves the title.

5.why: The picker has its own destination and uses repository storage, but the editor has no evidenced return refresh or result handoff.

6.why: The picker adds its own UiState/UiAction contract and ViewModel.
